replay: Last-Event-ID or after; persistent increasing id; consumers deduplicate by id
clock: occurredAt and receivedAt are actual Unix milliseconds on the exhibition PC. displayAt is the fictional message date for UI only; do not use it to schedule signals.
crossOrigin: Pass --event-origin https://exact-consumer-origin to the launcher. No destination is enabled by default.
inbox: Two conversations: daughter and neighbor (displayed as an unsaved number). Five exchanged daughter presets plus current-loop messages. messages.reset clears transient messages/replies in both conversations; event replay remains durable.

readSignal.emission: Once per scene.instance, when a current-scene incoming message is visible in its conversation. Opening before arrival emits when the first message arrives while that conversation is open.
readSignal.deduplication: Producer persists a unique scene.instance + :message.read event key. Replay can deliver the same event again: consumer must deduplicate by event.id (or scene.instance).
readSignal.nextLoop: A new scene.instance permits a new signal. No read means no signal.
readSignal.meaning: Conversation visibility, not proof that the visitor finished reading.
